summary.text: Laurie Schlegel is a Republican member of the Louisiana House of Representatives representing District 82, which the legislature's member page lists as covering Jefferson Parish. First elected in 2021, Laurie Schlegel chairs the Education Committee.

paragraphs.text: The House page lists Laurie Schlegel's occupation as licensed professional counselor, with a master of arts in marriage and family counseling and a bachelor of science in psychology.

The House page lists Laurie Schlegel's committee assignments as Education (chair) and House Select Committee on Women and Children, and caucus and delegation affiliations as Jefferson Parish Legislative Delegation, Louisiana Legislative Women's Caucus, and Louisiana Republican Legislative Delegation.
